description: Get the core amCharts 5 reference (SKILL.md) — covers setup, colors, themes, legends, tooltips, events, data, adapters, disposal, and common pitfalls. It is the base for every chart type; the chart-specific references build on it. It comes as an overview: its first sections, up to 12,000 characters, and a list of the others, each of which get_section("SKILL", heading) returns. With `full: true` it is the whole file.

full.description: true: the whole SKILL.md (about 105,000 characters). false (default): the overview.

name: get_core_reference
title: Get core reference (setup, themes, pitfalls)
